title: Commanders Advice
description: The frontmatter of a commander's advice file (CA): the commander's own answer to a dossier and the requests under it, written on his desk. Filed by identifier alone, CA001.md. The pilot creates the file as an empty shell when it writes the request, so the commander has somewhere to answer without being asked to make a file; status says whether the body is his yet.

type.description: the words Commanders Advice, which is what chooses this schema

unit.description: this advice file's identifier, CA and three digits, the same identifier the file is named for

context.description: the identifiers this advice answers, a bracketed list: the dossier and the requests under it

status.description: awaiting while the file is a shell the pilot has created and the commander has not yet answered, answered once the body is his. Absent means answered, so a file written before this existed needs no change

stamp.description: three items: the date as YYYY-MM-DD, the hand that last wrote the document, and the eight-character session id. On a shell these are the pilot's creation facts and status is awaiting; they become the commander's when he fills the body
